title: Operation Condor
cast: Jackie Chan, Carol Cheng, Eva Cobo
overview: Hired by a Spanish baron, Hong Kong treasure hunter Jackie, a.k.a. "Asian Hawk" and his entourage seek WWII Nazi gold buried in the Sahara Desert.
tagline: On his most dangerous mission ever, the world's toughest secret agent isn't going in alone.

title: Hoodwinked!
cast: Anne Hathaway, Glenn Close, Patrick Warburton
overview: Little Red Riding Hood: A classic story, but there's more to every tale than meets the eye. Before you judge a book by its cover, you've got to flip through the pages. In the re-telling of this classic fable, the story begins at the end of the tale and winds its way back. Chief Grizzly and Detective Bill Stork investigate a domestic disturbance at Granny's cottage, involving a karate-kicking Red Riding Hood, a sarcastic wolf and an oafish Woodsman.
tagline: Red Riding Hood. The Woodsman. Granny. The Wolf. Not Your Typical Crime. Not Your Usual Suspects.

title: Valentine
cast: Denise Richards, David Boreanaz, Marley Shelton
overview: Four friends start to receive morbid Valentine cards and realise they are being stalked by someone they had spurned 13 years ago. A masked killer is on the loose and Valentine's day is soon approaching.
tagline: Remember that kid everyone ignored on Valentine’s Day? He remembers you.

title: The New Guy
cast: DJ Qualls, Eliza Dushku, Zooey Deschanel
overview: Nerdy high school senior Dizzy Harrison has finally gotten lucky -- after purposely getting expelled, he takes lessons in 'badass cool' from a convict and enrolls at a new school. But can he keep up the ruse?
tagline: A zero will rise.

title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
original_title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
cast: Donald Pleasence, Paul Rudd, Marianne Hagan
overview: Six years after being presumed dead in a fire, and just as the town prepares to finally celebrate Halloween again, Michael Myers returns to Haddonfield to continue his reign of terror.
tagline: Terror never rests in peace.

title: Diabolique
cast: Sharon Stone, Isabelle Adjani, Chazz Palminteri
overview: The wife and mistress of a cruel school master collaborate in a carefully planned and executed scheme to murder him. The plan goes well until the body, which has been strategically dumped, disappears. The psychological strain starts to weigh on the two women when a retired police investigator begins looking into the man's disappearance on a whim.
tagline: Two women. One man. The combination can be murder.

title: Mulholland Falls
cast: Nick Nolte, Melanie Griffith, Chazz Palminteri
overview: In 1950s Los Angeles, a special crime squad of the LAPD investigates the murder of a young woman.
tagline: The power of love vs. the love of power.

title: Pokémon 3: The Movie
original_title: 劇場版ポケットモンスター 結晶塔の帝王 ENTEI
cast: Rica Matsumoto, Ikue Otani, Yuji Ueda
overview: When the sadness of her father's disappearance gets to Molly Hale, she unknowingly uses the Unown to create her own dream world along with Entei, who she believes to be her father. When Entei kidnaps Ash's mother, Ash — alongside Misty and Brock — invade the mansion looking for his mom and trying to stop the mysteries of Molly's Dream World and Entei!
tagline: This spring the Unown spells adventure.

title: Cats & Dogs
cast: Jeff Goldblum, Elizabeth Perkins, Alexander Pollock
overview: When a professor develops a vaccine that eliminates human allergies to dogs, he unwittingly upsets the fragile balance of power between cats and dogs and touches off an epic battle for pet supremacy. The fur flies as the feline faction, led by Mr. Tinkles, squares off against wide-eyed puppy Lou and his canine cohorts.
tagline: Things Are Gonna Get Hairy!

title: White Oleander
cast: Alison Lohman, Michelle Pfeiffer, Renée Zellweger
overview: A teenager journeys through a series of foster homes after her mother goes to prison for committing a crime of passion.

title: Stuart Little 2
cast: Michael J. Fox, Geena Davis, Hugh Laurie
overview: Stuart, an adorable white mouse, still lives happily with his adoptive family, the Littles, on the east side of Manhattan's Central Park. More crazy mouse adventures are in store as Stuart, his human brother, George, and their mischievous cat, Snowbell, set out to rescue a friend.
tagline: A Little goes a long way.

title: Farewell My Concubine
cast: Leslie Cheung, Zhang Fengyi, Gong Li
overview: In an epic tale of theater, gender, love and class, two Beijing opera actors navigate political turmoil as their friendship evolves over decades.
tagline: The passionate triangle of two lifelong friends and the woman who comes between them!

title: Fatal Attraction
cast: Michael Douglas, Glenn Close, Anne Archer
overview: A married man's one-night stand comes back to haunt him when that lover begins to stalk him and his family.
tagline: A look that led to an evening. A mistake he'll regret... FOR THE REST OF HIS LIFE.

title: Commando
cast: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Rae Dawn Chong, Dan Hedaya
overview: John Matrix, the former leader of a special commando strike force that always got the toughest jobs done, is forced back into action when his young daughter is kidnapped. To find her, Matrix has to fight his way through an array of punks, killers, one of his former commandos, and a fully equipped private army. With the help of a feisty stewardess and an old friend, Matrix has only a few hours to overcome his greatest challenge: finding his daughter before she's killed.
tagline: Somewhere, somehow, someone's going to pay.

title: The Birdcage
cast: Robin Williams, Gene Hackman, Nathan Lane
overview: A gay cabaret owner and his drag queen partner agree to put up a false heterosexual front so that their son can introduce them to his fiancée's conservative parents.
tagline: Come as you are.

title: Blue Streak
cast: Martin Lawrence, Luke Wilson, Dave Chappelle
overview: Miles Logan is a jewel thief who just hit the big time by stealing a huge diamond. However, after two years in jail, he comes to find out that he hid the diamond in a police building that was being built at the time of the robbery. In an attempt to regain his diamond, he poses as an LAPD detective.
tagline: He's a cop that's not. Believe that!

title: The Wedding Singer
cast: Adam Sandler, Drew Barrymore, Christine Taylor
overview: Robbie, a local rock star turned wedding singer, is dumped on the day of his wedding. Meanwhile, waitress Julia finally sets a wedding date with her fiancée Glenn. When Julia and Robbie meet and hit it off, they find that things are more complicated than anybody thought.
tagline: He's gonna party like it's 1985!

title: Wonder Boys
cast: Michael Douglas, Tobey Maguire, Frances McDormand
overview: Grady is a 50-ish English professor who hasn't had a thing published in years—not since he wrote his award winning 'Great American Novel' 7 years ago. This weekend proves even worse than he could imagine as he finds himself reeling from one misadventure to another in the company of a new wonder boy author.
tagline: Undependable. Unpredictable. Unforgettable.

title: Awakenings
cast: Robert De Niro, Robin Williams, John Heard
overview: Dr. Malcolm Sayer, a shy research physician, uses an experimental drug to "awaken" the catatonic victims of a rare disease. Leonard is the first patient to receive the controversial treatment. His awakening, filled with awe and enthusiasm, proves a rebirth for Sayer too, as the exuberant patient reveals life's simple but unutterably sweet pleasures to the introverted doctor.
tagline: There is no such thing as a simple miracle.

title: Smokey and the Bandit
cast: Burt Reynolds, Sally Field, Jerry Reed
overview: A race car driver tries to transport an illegal beer shipment from Texas to Atlanta in under 28 hours, picking up a reluctant bride-to-be on the way.
tagline: What we have here is a total lack of respect for the law!

title: Cheaper by the Dozen
cast: Steve Martin, Bonnie Hunt, Hilary Duff
overview: The Baker brood moves to Chicago after patriarch Tom gets a job coaching football at Northwestern University, forcing his writer wife, Kate, and the couple's 12 children to make a major adjustment. The transition works well until work demands pull the parents away from home, leaving the kids bored -- and increasingly mischievous.
tagline: The more...the scarier!

title: Saturday Night Fever
cast: John Travolta, Karen Lynn Gorney, Barry Miller
overview: Tony spends his Saturdays at a disco where his stylish moves raise his popularity among the patrons. But his life outside the disco is not easy and things change when he gets attracted to Stephanie.
tagline: Where do you go when the record is over...

title: The Postman
cast: Massimo Troisi, Philippe Noiret, Maria Grazia Cucinotta
overview: Simple Italian postman learns to love poetry while delivering mail to a famous poet; he uses this to woo local beauty Beatrice.
tagline: Dreams do come true.

title: Ri¢hie Ri¢h
cast: Macaulay Culkin, John Larroquette, Edward Herrmann
overview: Billionaire heir Richie Rich has it all, including Reggie Jackson as a batting coach and Claudia Schiffer as a personal trainer -- but no playmates. What's more, scoundrel Laurence Van Dough is scheming to take over the family empire. Uh-oh! Enter faithful butler Cadbury to save the day.
tagline: Five buddies, one butler, and a dog on an adventure so big... even the world's richest kid can't afford to miss it.

title: Damage
cast: Jeremy Irons, Juliette Binoche, Miranda Richardson
overview: The life of a respected British politician at the height of his career crumbles when he becomes obsessed with his son's lover.
tagline: Desire... Deceit... Destiny...

title: Secretary
cast: James Spader, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Jeremy Davies
overview: A young woman, recently released from a mental hospital, gets a job as a secretary to a demanding lawyer, where their employer-employee relationship turns into a sexual, sadomasochistic one.
tagline: Assume the position.

title: The Relic
cast: Penelope Ann Miller, Tom Sizemore, Linda Hunt
overview: A homicide detective teams up with an evolutionary biologist to hunt a giant creature that is killing people in a Chicago museum.
tagline: They did the unthinkable. They brought it back.

title: Billy Madison
cast: Adam Sandler, Bradley Whitford, Josh Mostel
overview: Billy Madison is the 27 year-old son of Bryan Madison, a very rich man who has made his living in the hotel industry. Billy stands to inherit his father's empire, but only if he can make it through all 12 grades, 2 weeks per grade, to prove that he has what it takes to run the family business.
tagline: To inherit his family's fortune, Billy is going back to school... Way back.

title: Year of the Dragon
cast: Mickey Rourke, John Lone, Ariane
overview: In New York, racist Capt. Stanley White becomes obsessed with destroying a Chinese-American drug ring run by Joey Tai, an up-and-coming young gangster as ambitious as he is ruthless. While pursuing an unauthorized investigation, White grows increasingly willing to violate police protocol, resorting to progressively violent measures -- even as his concerned wife, Connie, and his superiors beg him to consider the consequences of his actions.
tagline: It isn't the Bronx or Brooklyn, it isn't even New York. It's Chinatown... and it's about to explode.

title: Deep Blue
cast: Michael Gambon, David Attenborough, Pierce Brosnan
overview: Deep Blue is a major documentary feature film shot by the BBC Natural History Unit. An epic cinematic rollercoaster ride for all ages, Deep Blue uses amazing footage to tell us the story of our oceans and the life they support.

title: Narc
cast: Jason Patric, Ray Liotta, Chi McBride
overview: Narcotics Sergeant Nick Tellis, on leave after a trauma, is called back to investigate the murder of fellow undercover operative Michael Calvess, joined by the victim's unpredictable and brutal ex-partner, Henry Oak. Working together in the back alleys of Detroit, Tellis and Oak delve into a dark investigation that leads them to uncover shocking secrets and question the corruption and morality within the department, encountering unorthodox methods and a brutal truth about Calvess's death.

title: Thirteen
cast: Evan Rachel Wood, Nikki Reed, Holly Hunter
overview: When 13-year-old Tracy befriends Evie, the most popular girl in school, her life is turned upside down as Evie introduces her to a world of sex, drugs, and money. But it isn’t long before Tracy’s new lifestyle begins to take a heavy toll on her and her family.
tagline: It's happening so fast.

title: Scooby-Doo 2: Monsters Unleashed
cast: Freddie Prinze Jr., Sarah Michelle Gellar, Matthew Lillard
overview: A masked villain wreaks mayhem on the city of Coolsville with a monster machine that creates real-life versions of Mystery Inc.'s former foes like The 10,000 Volt Ghost, The Cotton Candy Glob, The Skelemen and The Pterodactyl Ghost. Fred, Daphne, Shaggy, Velma and Scooby-Doo launch an investigation into the monster outbreak that leaves Shaggy and Scooby questioning their roles in Mystery Inc. Eager to prove their detective skills, the ever-ravenous duo comes up with a secret plan to solve the mystery all by themselves. Can the gang unravel their most challenging case?
tagline: Doo the fright thing.

title: New York Minute
cast: Ashley Olsen, Mary-Kate Olsen, Eugene Levy
overview: Honors student Jane Ryan heads to Manhattan for a college-scholarship competition. Her rebellious twin Roxy tags along to crash a video shoot. But anything can happen – and does – in a romp involving a pursuing truant officer, a smuggler, hunkalicious guys, and the girls' realization that when the chips are down, a sister can be the best friend of all.
tagline: Anything can change in a New York minute.

title: Exorcist: The Beginning
cast: Stellan Skarsgård, Izabella Scorupco, James D'Arcy
overview: Years before Father Merrin helped save Regan MacNeil’s soul, he first encounters the demon Pazuzu in East Africa.
tagline: Go back to where the horror began.

title: The Postman Always Rings Twice
cast: Jack Nicholson, Jessica Lange, John Colicos
overview: The sensuous wife of a lunch wagon proprietor and a rootless drifter begin a sordidly steamy affair and conspire to murder her Greek husband.
tagline: You can get away with anything. Once.

title: The Big Easy
cast: Dennis Quaid, Ellen Barkin, Ned Beatty
overview: Remy McSwain is a New Orleans police lieutenant who investigates the murder of a local mobster. His investigation leads him to suspect that fellow members of the police force may be involved.
tagline: He's got to hide the truth. She'll stop at nothing to find it. But tonight, everything's off the record.

title: Zelig
cast: Woody Allen, Mia Farrow, Patrick Horgan
overview: Fictional documentary about the life of human chameleon Leonard Zelig, a man who becomes a celebrity in the 1920s due to his ability to look and act like whoever is around him. Clever editing places Zelig in real newsreel footage of Woodrow Wilson, Babe Ruth, and others.
tagline: You wanted more when it was all over!

title: This Is Spinal Tap
cast: Christopher Guest, Michael McKean, Harry Shearer
overview: "This Is Spinal Tap" shines a light on the self-contained universe of a metal band struggling to get back on the charts, including everything from its complicated history of ups and downs, gold albums, name changes and undersold concert dates, along with the full host of requisite groupies, promoters, hangers-on and historians, sessions, release events and those special behind-the-scenes moments that keep it all real.
tagline: Prepare to crank those amps up to eleven.

title: Dressed to Kill
cast: Nancy Allen, Michael Caine, Angie Dickinson
overview: After witnessing a mysterious woman brutally slay a homemaker, prostitute Liz Blake finds herself trapped in a dangerous situation. While the police thinks she is the murderer, the real killer is intent on silencing her only witness.
tagline: The latest fashion in murder.

title: The Great Gatsby
cast: Robert Redford, Mia Farrow, Bruce Dern
overview: Nick Carraway, a young Midwesterner now living on Long Island, finds himself fascinated by the mysterious past and lavish lifestyle of his neighbor, the nouveau riche Jay Gatsby. He is drawn into Gatsby's circle, becoming a witness to obsession and tragedy.
tagline: Gone is the romance that was so divine

title: The Notebook
cast: Ryan Gosling, Rachel McAdams, Gena Rowlands
overview: An epic love story centered around an older man who reads aloud to a woman with Alzheimer's. From a faded notebook, the old man's words bring to life the story about a couple who is separated by World War II, and is then passionately reunited, seven years later, after they have taken different paths.
tagline: Behind every great love is a great story.

title: Iron Eagle
cast: Louis Gossett Jr., Jason Gedrick, David Suchet
overview: When Doug's father, an Air Force Pilot, is shot down by MiGs belonging to a radical Middle Eastern state, no one seems able to get him out. Doug finds Chappy, an Air Force Colonel who is intrigued by the idea of sending in two fighters piloted by himself and Doug to rescue Doug's father after bombing the MiG base.
tagline: Break the sound barrier.

title: Tough Guys
cast: Burt Lancaster, Kirk Douglas, Charles Durning
overview: Harry Doyle and Archie Lang are two old-time train robbers, who held up a train in 1956 and have been incarcerated for thirty years. After serving their time, they are released from jail and have to adjust to a new life of freedom. and soon realize that they still have the pizzazz when, picking up their prison checks at a bank, they foil a robbery attempt.
tagline: They're Out To Teach A New World Some Old Tricks.

title: The Beverly Hillbillies
cast: Jim Varney, Diedrich Bader, Erika Eleniak
overview: Mild-mannered dirt-poor hill-dweller Jed Clampett strikes it rich when oil is discovered on his property. At cousin Pearl's insistence, he moves his family to Beverly Hills to better enjoy his newfound wealth.
tagline: Upscale neighborhood, down-home heart.

title: The Barbarian Invasions
collection_name: The Decline of the American Empire Collection
cast: Rémy Girard, Stéphane Rousseau, Marie-Josée Croze
overview: In this belated sequel to 'The Decline of the American Empire', middle-aged Montreal college professor, Remy, learns that he is dying of liver cancer. His ex-wife, Louise, asks their estranged son, Sebastian, a successful businessman living in London, to come home. Sebastian makes the impossible happen, using his contacts and disrupting the Canadian healthcare system in every way possible to help his father fight his terminal illness to the bitter end, while reuniting some of Remy's old friends, including Pierre, Alain, Dominique, Diane, and Claude, who return to see their friend before he passes on.
tagline: A comedy about sex, friendship, and all other things that invade our lives.

title: Taxi
cast: Queen Latifah, Jimmy Fallon, Gisele Bündchen
overview: A mouthy and feisty taxicab driver has hot tips for a green and inept cop set on solving a string of New York City bank robberies committed by a quartet of female Brazilian bank robbers.
tagline: Take a Ride on the Wild Side.

title: Where Eagles Dare
cast: Richard Burton, Clint Eastwood, Mary Ure
overview: World War II is raging, and an American general has been captured and is being held hostage in the Schloss Adler, a Bavarian castle that's nearly impossible to breach. It's up to a group of skilled Allied soldiers to liberate the general before it's too late.
tagline: One weekend Major Smith, Lieutenant Schaffer, and a beautiful blonde named Mary decided to win World War II.

title: Interstella 5555: The 5tory of the 5ecret 5tar 5ystem
director_name: Hirotoshi Rissen, Kazuhisa Takenouchi, Leiji Matsumoto, Daisuke Nishio
cast: Romanthony, Thomas Bangalter
overview: Four talented alien musicians are kidnapped by a record producer who disguises them as humans. Shep, a space pilot in love with bass player Stella, follows them to Earth. Reprogrammed to forget their real identities and renamed The Crescendolls, the group quickly becomes a huge success playing soulless corporate pop. At a concert, Shep manages to free all the musicians except Stella, and the band sets out to rediscover who they really are — and to rescue Stella.
tagline: The animated House Musical.

title: Terms of Endearment
cast: Shirley MacLaine, Debra Winger, Jack Nicholson
overview: Aurora, a finicky woman, is in search of true love while her daughter faces marital issues. Together, they help each other deal with problems and find reasons to live a joyful life.
tagline: Come to laugh, come to cry, come to care, come to terms.

title: The Last Temptation of Christ
cast: Willem Dafoe, Harvey Keitel, Paul Greco
overview: Jesus, a humble Judean carpenter beginning to see that he is the son of God, is drawn into revolutionary action against the Roman occupiers by Judas -- despite his protestations that love, not violence, is the path to salvation. The burden of being the savior of mankind torments Jesus throughout his life, leading him to doubt.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Movie
cast: Dan Green, Eric Stuart, Scott Rayow
overview: After the conclusion of the Battle City Tournament, deep below the sands of Egypt, an ancient evil has awakened. Anubis, who was defeated centuries ago by Yugi’s mysterious alter ego – the ancient Pharaoh – has returned for revenge. Wielding the power of the Eighth Millennium Item, Anubis is determined to destroy Yugi and take over the world.
tagline: Everything else was just practice!

title: Hairspray
cast: Ricki Lake, Divine, Debbie Harry
overview: 'Pleasantly plump' teenager Tracy Turnblad achieves her dream of becoming a regular on the Corny Collins Dance Show. Now a teen hero, she starts using her fame to speak out for the causes she believes in, most of all integration. In doing so, she earns the wrath of the show's former star, Amber Von Tussle, as well as Amber's manipulative, pro-segregation parents. The rivalry comes to a head as Amber and Tracy vie for the title of Miss Auto Show 1963.
tagline: The world was in a mess... but their hair was perfect!!

title: Darkness
cast: Anna Paquin, Lena Olin, Iain Glen
overview: A teenage girl moves into a remote country home with her family, only to discover that the gloomy old house has a horrifying past that threatens to destroy them.
tagline: Some secrets should never come to light.

title: Godsend
cast: Greg Kinnear, Rebecca Romijn, Robert De Niro
overview: A couple agree to have their deceased son cloned under the supervision of an enigmatic doctor, but bizarre things start to happen years after his rebirth.
tagline: When a miracle becomes a nightmare, evil is born.

title: House of the Dead
primary_production_company: Boll Kino Beteiligungs GmbH & Co. KG
cast: Jonathan Cherry, Tyron Leitso, Clint Howard
overview: On an island off the coast, a techno rave party attracts a diverse group of college coeds and a Coast Guard officer. Soon, they discover that their X-laced escapades are to be interrupted by zombies and monsters that attack them on the ground, from the air, and in the sea, ruled by an evil entity.
tagline: You won't last the night.

title: Internal Affairs
cast: Richard Gere, Andy Garcia, Nancy Travis
overview: Keen young Raymold Avila joins the Internal Affairs Department of the Los Angeles police. He and partner Amy Wallace are soon looking closely at the activities of cop Dennis Peck whose financial holdings start to suggest something shady. Indeed Peck is involved in any number of dubious or downright criminal activities. He is also devious, a womaniser, and a clever manipulator, and he starts to turn his attention on Avila.
tagline: Trust him... he's a cop.

title: City Hall
cast: Al Pacino, John Cusack, Bridget Fonda
overview: The accidental shooting of a boy in New York City leads to an investigation by the Deputy Mayor, and unexpectedly far-reaching consequences.
tagline: It started with a shootout on a rainswept street and ended in a scandal that shattered New York.

title: Brewster's Millions
cast: Richard Pryor, John Candy, Lonette McKee
overview: Monty Brewster, an aging minor-league baseball player, stands to inherit $300 million if he can successfully spend $30 million in 30 days without anything to show for it, and without telling anyone what he's up to... A task that's a lot harder than it sounds!
tagline: You don't have to be crazy to blow 30 million dollars in 30 days. But it helps.

title: Boomerang
cast: Eddie Murphy, Robin Givens, Halle Berry
overview: Marcus is a successful advertising executive who woos and beds women almost at will. After a company merger he finds that his new boss, the ravishing Jacqueline, is treating him in exactly the same way. Completely traumatised by this, his work goes badly downhill.
tagline: A player who's about to be played.

title: Major League II
cast: Charlie Sheen, Tom Berenger, Corbin Bernsen
overview: After losing in the ALCS the year before, the Cleveland Indians are determined to make it into the World Series this time! However, they first have to contend with Rachel Phelps again when she buys back the team.
tagline: The dream team is back!

title: Blazing Saddles
cast: Cleavon Little, Gene Wilder, Slim Pickens
overview: A town—where everyone seems to be named Johnson—stands in the way of the railroad. In order to grab their land, robber baron Hedley Lamarr sends his henchmen to make life in the town unbearable. After the sheriff is killed, the town demands a new sheriff from the Governor, so Hedley convinces him to send the town the first black sheriff in the west.
tagline: ...or never give a saga an even break!

title: Striking Distance
cast: Bruce Willis, Sarah Jessica Parker, Dennis Farina
overview: Coming from a police family, Tom Hardy ends up fighting his uncle after the murder of his father. Tom believes the killer is another cop, and goes on the record with his allegations. Demoted to water-way duty Tom, along with new partner Jo Christman, navigate the three rivers looking for clues and discovering bodies. This time the victims are women Tom knows, he must find the killer to prove his innocence.
tagline: They shouldn't have put him in the water, if they didn't want him to make waves.

title: Fly Away Home
cast: Jeff Daniels, Anna Paquin, Dana Delany
overview: Amy is only 13 years old when her mother is killed. She goes to Canada to live with her father, an eccentric inventor whom she barely knows. Amy is miserable in her new life... until she discovers a nest of goose eggs that were abandoned when a local forest was torn down. The eggs hatch and Amy becomes "Mama Goose". When winter comes, Amy and her dad must find a way to lead the birds South.
tagline: To achieve the incredible, you have to attempt the impossible.

title: Problem Child
cast: John Ritter, Jack Warden, Michael J. Oliver
overview: Ben Healy and his social climbing wife Flo adopt fun-loving seven year old Junior. But they soon discover he's a little monster as he turns a camping trip, a birthday party and even a baseball game into comic nightmares.
tagline: Attila the Hun. Ivan the Terrible. Al Capone. They were all seven once.

title: Taking Lives
cast: Angelina Jolie, Ethan Hawke, Kiefer Sutherland
overview: Recruited to assist Montreal police in their desperate search for a serial killer who assumes the identities of his victims, FBI profiler Illeana Scott knows it's only a matter of time before the killer strikes again. Her most promising lead is a museum employee who might be the killer's only eyewitness.
tagline: He would kill to be you.

title: Mutiny on the Bounty
cast: Marlon Brando, Trevor Howard, Richard Harris
overview: The Bounty leaves Portsmouth in 1787. Its destination: to sail to Tahiti and load bread-fruit. Captain Bligh will do anything to get there as fast as possible, using any means to keep up a strict discipline. When they arrive at Tahiti, it is like a paradise for the crew, something completely different than the living hell aboard the ship. On the way back to England, officer Fletcher Christian becomes the leader of a mutiny.
tagline: The mightiest excitement that ever swept across the sea or the screen!

title: The Majestic
cast: Jim Carrey, Martin Landau, Laurie Holden
overview: Set in 1951, a blacklisted Hollywood writer gets into a car accident, loses his memory and settles down in a small town where he is mistaken for a long-lost son.
tagline: Sometimes your life comes into focus one frame at a time.

title: The Hand That Rocks the Cradle
original_title: The Hand That Rocks the Cradle
cast: Annabella Sciorra, Rebecca De Mornay, Matt McCoy
overview: A suburban family chooses seemingly sweet Peyton Flanders as their newborn's nanny. Only much later does the infant's mother, Claire Bartel, realize Peyton's true intentions -- to destroy Claire and replace her in the family. The nail-biting suspense builds quickly in this chilling psychological thriller about deception and bitter revenge.
tagline: Trust is her weapon. Innocence her opportunity. Revenge her only desire.

title: Heist
cast: Gene Hackman, Danny DeVito, Delroy Lindo
overview: Joe Moore has a job he loves. He's a thief. His job goes sour when he gets caught on security camera tape. His fence, Bergman, reneges on the money he's owed, and his wife may be betraying him with the fence's young lieutenant. Moore and his partner, Bobby Blane, and their utility man, Pinky Pincus, find themselves broke, betrayed, and blackmailed. Moore is forced to commit his crew to do one last big job.
tagline: It isn't love that makes the world go round.

title: The Animal
cast: Rob Schneider, Colleen Haskell, John C. McGinley
overview: When loser Marvin Mange is involved in a horrible car accident, he's brought back to life by a deranged scientist as half man and half animal. His newfound powers are awesome -- but their adverse side effects could take over his life. Now, Marvin must fight to control his crazy primal urges around his new squeeze, Rianna, and his rival, Sgt. Sisk, who both think he's one cool cat.
tagline: He wasn't much of a man... Now he's not much of an animal!

title: Riding in Cars with Boys
cast: Drew Barrymore, Steve Zahn, Adam Garcia
overview: In 1965, a young woman with dreams of becoming a writer has a son at the age of 15 and struggles to make things work with the drug-addicted father.
tagline: She did everything wrong, but got everything right.

title: Presumed Innocent
cast: Harrison Ford, Brian Dennehy, Raúl Juliá
overview: Rusty Sabich is a deputy prosecutor engaged in an obsessive affair with a coworker who is murdered. Soon after, he's accused of the crime. And his fight to clear his name becomes a whirlpool of lies and hidden passions.
tagline: Some people would kill for love

title: House of Sand and Fog
cast: Jennifer Connelly, Ben Kingsley, Ron Eldard
overview: Behrani, an Iranian immigrant buys a California bungalow, thinking he can fix it up, sell it again, and make enough money to send his son to college. However, the house is the legal property of former drug addict Kathy. After losing the house in an unfair legal dispute with the county, she is left with nowhere to go. Wanting her house back, she hires a lawyer and befriends a police officer. Neither Kathy nor Behrani have broken the law, so they find themselves involved in a difficult moral dilemma.
tagline: Some dreams can't be shared.

title: Hide and Seek
cast: Robert De Niro, Dakota Fanning, Famke Janssen
overview: David Callaway tries to piece together his life in the wake of his wife's suicide and has been left to raise his nine-year-old daughter, Emily on his own. David is at first amused to discover that Emily has created an imaginary friend named 'Charlie', but it isn't long before 'Charlie' develops a sinister and violent side, and as David struggles with his daughter's growing emotional problems, he comes to the frightening realisation that 'Charlie' isn't just a figment of Emily's imagination.
tagline: Come out, come out, whatever you are.

title: Eddie
cast: Whoopi Goldberg, Frank Langella, Dennis Farina
overview: Eddie is a New York limo driver and a fanatical follower of the New York Knicks professional basketball team. The team is struggling with a mediocre record when, in mid-season, "Wild Bill" Burgess, the new owner, as a public relations gimmick, stages an 'honorary coach' contest, which Eddie wins. The fans love it, so "Wild Bill" fires the coach and hires her. She takes the bunch of overpaid prima
tagline: The newest coach in the NBA has got the Knicks right where she wants them.

title: Vera Drake
cast: Imelda Staunton, Phil Davis, Sally Hawkins
overview: Abortionist Vera Drake finds her beliefs and practices clash with the mores of 1950s Britain – a conflict that leads to tragedy for her family.
tagline: Wife. Mother. Criminal.

title: The Associate
cast: Whoopi Goldberg, Dianne Wiest, Eli Wallach
overview: Laurel Ayres is a businesswoman trying to make it but unfortunately she works at a investment firm where she does all the work but all the senior investors like Frank Peterson grab all the credit. She then leaves and starts her own firm. While trying to find clients Laurel pretends that she has a male partner named Robert Cutty. And when she starts to do well all of her clients wants to meet Cutty which is difficult since he doesn't exist.
tagline: Behind every great man is a woman... Wishing he'd get the hell out of her way.

title: My Fair Lady
cast: Audrey Hepburn, Rex Harrison, Stanley Holloway
overview: A snobbish phonetics professor agrees to a wager that he can take a flower girl and make her presentable in high society.
tagline: The loverliest motion picture of them all!

title: The Mosquito Coast
cast: Harrison Ford, Helen Mirren, River Phoenix
overview: An inventor spurns his city life and moves his family into the jungles of Central America to make a utopia.
tagline: He never bargained for what he found.

title: Tess
cast: Nastassja Kinski, Peter Firth, Leigh Lawson
overview: A strong-willed peasant girl is sent by her father to the estate of some local aristocrats to capitalize on a rumour that their families are from the same line. This fateful visit commences an epic narrative of sex, class, betrayal, and revenge.
tagline: She was born into a world where they called it seduction, not rape. What she did would shatter that world forever.

title: Earthquake
cast: Charlton Heston, Ava Gardner, George Kennedy
overview: Various interconnected people struggle to survive when an earthquake of unimaginable magnitude hits Los Angeles, California.
tagline: When the big one finally hits L.A.

title: Ladder 49
cast: Joaquin Phoenix, John Travolta, Jacinda Barrett
overview: Under the watchful eye of his mentor, Captain Mike Kennedy, probationary firefighter Jack Morrison matures into a seasoned veteran at a Baltimore fire station. However, Jack has reached a crossroads  as the sacrifices he's made have put him in harm's way innumerable times and significantly impacted his relationship with his wife and kids.
tagline: Their greatest challenge lies in rescuing one of their own.

title: Human Traffic
cast: John Simm, Shaun Parkes, Nicola Reynolds
overview: For Jip, Lulu, Koop, Nina, and Moff, the dead-end jobs they endure during the week just kill the time until Friday night. That's when they cut very loose and get on the rollercoaster ride that takes them right through to Monday morning.
tagline: The weekend has landed.

title: The Princess Diaries 2: Royal Engagement
cast: Anne Hathaway, Julie Andrews, Héctor Elizondo
overview: Mia Thermopolis is now a college graduate and on her way to Genovia to take up her duties as princess. Accompanied by her friend Lilly, Mia continues her 'princess lessons', like riding horses side-saddle and archery. But her already complicated life is turned upside down once again when she learns that she is to take the crown as queen earlier than expected, all while she meets a mysteriously charming young man.
tagline: It can take a lifetime to find true love; she's got 30 days!

title: Confessions of a Teenage Drama Queen
original_title: Confessions of a Teenage Drama Queen
cast: Lindsay Lohan, Adam Garcia, Glenne Headly
overview: After moving to New Jersey, Lola bags a coveted role in a school play, which earns her the wrath of Carla, the most popular girl in school, who will do anything to ruin Lola's life.
tagline: So much drama, so little time.

title: Poltergeist II: The Other Side
cast: Craig T. Nelson, JoBeth Williams, Heather O'Rourke
overview: The Freeling family move in with Diane's mother in an effort to escape the trauma and aftermath of Carol Anne's abduction by the Beast. But the Beast is not to be put off so easily and appears in a ghostly apparition as the Reverend Kane, a religious zealot responsible for the deaths of his many followers. His goal is simple - he wants the angelic Carol Anne.
tagline: "They're back."

title: The Rescuers Down Under
cast: Bob Newhart, Eva Gabor, John Candy
overview: A lawless poacher wants to capture a majestic and rare golden eagle, so he kidnaps the boy who knows where to find the bird. Not to worry -- the Rescue Aid Society's top agents, heroic mice Miss Bianca and Bernard, fly to Australia to save the day. Accompanying the fearless duo are bumbling albatross Wilbur and local field operative Jake the Kangaroo Rat.
tagline: Hang on for the most thrilling ride of your life!

title: The Prince & Me
cast: Julia Stiles, Luke Mably, Ben Miller
overview: A fairy tale love-story about pre-med student Paige who falls in love with a Danish Prince "Eddie" who refused to follow the traditions of his parents and has come to the US to quench his thirst for rebellion. Paige and Edward come from two different worlds, but there is an undeniable attraction between them.
tagline: Finding your inner princess can be such a royal pain.

title: Laws of Attraction
cast: Pierce Brosnan, Julianne Moore, Michael Sheen
overview: Amidst a sea of litigation, two New York City divorce lawyers find love.
tagline: Love always has the last word.

title: The Ruins
cast: Jonathan Tucker, Jena Malone, Shawn Ashmore
overview: Americans Amy, Stacy, Jeff and Eric look for fun during a sunny holiday in Mexico, but they get much more than that after visiting an archaeological dig in the jungle.
tagline: Terror has evolved.

title: National Lampoon's Vacation
cast: Chevy Chase, Beverly D'Angelo, Anthony Michael Hall
overview: Clark Griswold is on a quest to take his family to the Walley World theme park for a vacation, but things don't go exactly as planned.
tagline: Every summer Chevy Chase takes his family on a little trip. This year he went too far.

title: She-Devil
cast: Meryl Streep, Roseanne Barr, Ed Begley Jr.
overview: A cunning and resourceful housewife vows revenge on her husband when he begins an affair with a wealthy romance novelist.
tagline: The story of the greatest evil ever known to man... His ex-wife.

title: Honey, I Blew Up the Kid
original_title: Honey, I Blew Up the Kid
collection_name: Honey, I Shrunk the Kids Collection
cast: Rick Moranis, Marcia Strassman, Robert Oliveri
overview: Wayne Szalinski is at it again. But instead of shrinking things, he tries to make a machine that can make things grow. As in the first one, his machine isn't quite accurate. But when he brings Nick & his toddler son Adam to see his invention, the machine unexpectedly starts working. And when Adam comes right up to the machine, he gets zapped along with his stuffed bunny.
tagline: The BIG Laughs Start January 6th!

title: Secrets & Lies
cast: Brenda Blethyn, Marianne Jean-Baptiste, Timothy Spall
overview: After her adoptive mother dies, Hortense, a successful black optometrist, seeks out her birth mother. She's shocked when her research leads her to Cynthia, a working class white woman.
tagline: Roxanne drives her mother crazy. Maurice never speaks to his niece. Cynthia has a shock for her family. Monica can't talk to her husband. Hortense has never met her mother.

title: The Merchant of Venice
cast: Al Pacino, Jeremy Irons, Joseph Fiennes
overview: Venice, 1596. Bassanio begs his friend Antonio, a prosperous merchant, to lend him a large sum of money so that he can woo Portia, a very wealthy heiress; but Antonio has invested his fortune abroad, so they turn to Shylock, a Jewish moneylender, and ask him for a loan.

title: Tora! Tora! Tora!
director_name: Kinji Fukasaku, Richard Fleischer, Toshio Masuda
cast: Martin Balsam, So Yamamura, Jason Robards
overview: In the summer of 1941, the United States and Japan seem on the brink of war after constant embargos and failed diplomacy come to no end. "Tora! Tora! Tora!", named after the code words used by the lead Japanese pilot to indicate they had surprised the Americans, covers the days leading up to the attack on Pearl Harbor, which plunged America into the Second World War.
tagline: The incredible attack on Pearl Harbor.

title: Spartan
cast: Val Kilmer, Derek Luke, William H. Macy
overview: U.S. government agent Scott is assigned to rescue the daughter of a high-ranking government official. As willing as he is to bend the rules to get things done, though, Scott is shocked to find that others are willing to go even further to protect a political career.
tagline: She's missing.

title: We Are Marshall
cast: Matthew McConaughey, Matthew Fox, Anthony Mackie
overview: When a plane crash claims the lives of members of the Marshall University football team and some of its fans, the team's new coach and his surviving players try to keep the football program alive.
tagline: From the ashes we rose.

title: Mysterious Skin
cast: Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brady Corbet, Michelle Trachtenberg
overview: A teenage hustler and a young man obsessed with alien abductions cross paths, together discovering a horrible, liberating truth.
tagline: Two boys. One can't remember. The other can't forget.

title: Music and Lyrics
cast: Drew Barrymore, Hugh Grant, Brad Garrett
overview: A washed-up '80s pop star gets a chance at a comeback when reigning pop diva Cora Corman invites him to write & record a duet with her, but there's a problem--Alex hasn't written a song in years; he's never written lyrics and he has to come up with a hit in a matter of days.
tagline: Share the music with someone you love.

title: The Muppet Movie
cast: Jim Henson, Frank Oz, Jerry Nelson
overview: The Muppets gather to watch their newly-finished big-budget rich-and-famous feature film: a talent agent persuades Kermit the Frog to leave the swamp to pursue a career in Hollywood. On his way there, he meets a bear, a pig, a whatever (his future muppet crew), and some special celebrity guest stars, while being chased by the desperate owner of a frog-leg restaurant!
tagline: More entertaining than humanly possible!

title: Mask
cast: Cher, Sam Elliott, Eric Stoltz
overview: A significantly deformed but highly intelligent teenage boy and his biker gang mother attempt to live as normal a life as possible under the circumstances.
tagline: They told 16 year old Rocky Dennis he could never be like everyone else. So he was determined to be better.

title: Kinsey
cast: Liam Neeson, Laura Linney, Chris O'Donnell
overview: Kinsey is a portrait of researcher Alfred Kinsey, driven to uncover the most private secrets of a nation. What begins for Kinsey as a scientific endeavor soon takes on an intensely personal relevance, ultimately becoming an unexpected journey into the mystery of human behavior.
tagline: Let's talk about sex

title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
original_title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
cast: Richard Pryor, Gene Wilder, Joan Severance
overview: A murder takes place in the shop of David Lyons, a deaf man who fails to hear the gunshot being fired. Outside, blind man Wally Karue hears the shot, but cannot see the perpetrator. Both are arrested, but escape to form an unlikely partnership. Being chased by both the law AND the original killers, can the pair work together to outwit them all?
tagline: MURDER! The blind guy couldn't see it. The deaf guy couldn't hear it. Now they're both wanted for it.

title: Child's Play 2
cast: Alex Vincent, Brad Dourif, Christine Elise
overview: Chucky is reconstructed by a toy factory to dispel the negative publicity surrounding the doll, and tracks young Andy Barclay to a foster home where the chase begins again.
tagline: Sorry Jack... Chucky's back!

title: Child's Play 3
cast: Justin Whalin, Brad Dourif, Perrey Reeves
overview: Eight years after seemingly destroying the killer doll, teen Andy Barclay is placed in a military school, and the spirit of Chucky returns to renew his quest and seek vengeance after being recreated from a mass of melted plastic.
tagline: There comes a time to put away childhood things. But some things won't stay put!

title: Mystic Pizza
cast: Julia Roberts, Annabeth Gish, Lili Taylor
overview: Three teenage girls come of age while working at a pizza parlor in Mystic, Connecticut.
tagline: A romantic comedy with the works.

title: Evil
cast: Andreas Wilson, Henrik Lundström, Gustaf Skarsgård
overview: Stockholm, in the 1950s.  Erik is expelled from the local school for getting into one brawl too many. To protect Erik from his violent stepfather’s reaction to his expulsion, Erik's mother arranges for Erik to spend a year at Stjärnsberg Boarding School, the only school willing to accept him. This is Erik's last chance to graduate to Upper School and he promises his mother, for his and her sake, to do all he can to stay out of trouble.
tagline: It's time to take a stand.

title: Wild Hogs
cast: Tim Allen, John Travolta, Martin Lawrence
overview: Restless and ready for an adventure, four suburban bikers leave the safety of their subdivision and head out on the open road. But complications ensue when they cross paths with an intimidating band of New Mexico bikers known as the Del Fuegos.
tagline: A lot can happen on the road to nowhere.

title: Patton
cast: George C. Scott, Karl Malden, Stephen Young
overview: "Patton" tells the tale of General George S. Patton, famous tank commander of World War II. The film begins with Patton's career in North Africa and progresses through the invasion of Germany and the fall of the Third Reich. Side plots also speak of Patton's numerous faults such his temper and habit towards insubordination.
tagline: The Rebel Warrior

title: Wicker Park
cast: Josh Hartnett, Rose Byrne, Matthew Lillard
overview: Matthew, a young advertising executive in Chicago, puts his life and a business trip to China on hold when he thinks he sees Lisa, the love of his life who left him without a word two years earlier, walking out of a restaurant one day.
tagline: Passion never dies.

title: Baby's Day Out
cast: Joe Mantegna, Lara Flynn Boyle, Joe Pantoliano
overview: Baby Bink couldn't ask for more: he has adoring (if somewhat sickly-sweet) parents, lives in a huge mansion, and he's just about to appear in the social pages of the paper. Unfortunately, not everyone in the world is as nice as Baby Bink's parents—especially the three enterprising kidnappers who pretend to be photographers from the newspaper. Successfully kidnapping Baby Bink, they have a harder time keeping hold of the rascal, who not only keeps one step ahead of them, but seems to be more than a little bit smarter than the three bumbling criminals.
tagline: No bib. No crib. No problem.

title: Baby Boom
cast: Diane Keaton, Sam Shepard, Harold Ramis
overview: J.C. Wiatt is a talented and ambitious New York City career woman who is married to her job and working towards partner at her firm. She has a live-in relationship with Steven, a successful investment broker who, along with J.C., agreed children aren't part of the plan. J.C.'s life takes an unexpected turn when a distant relative dies and the will appoints her the caretaker of their baby girl, Elizabeth. The baby's sudden arrival causes Steven to leave, breaking off their relationship. Juggling power lunches and powdered formula, she is soon forced off the fast track by a conniving colleague and a bigoted boss. But she won't stay down for long. She'll prove to the world that a woman can have it all and on her own terms too!
tagline: JC Wiatt, corporate powerhouse, just received an inheritance. And it sucks.

title: Cinema Paradiso
cast: Philippe Noiret, Jacques Perrin, Marco Leonardi
overview: A filmmaker recalls his childhood, when he fell in love with the movies at his village's theater and formed a deep friendship with the theater's projectionist.
tagline: An enchanted village. A wonderful friendship. Star-crossed lovers. And the magic of the movies.

title: Club Dread
cast: Kevin Heffernan, Jay Chandrasekhar, Brittany Daniel
overview: When a serial killer interrupts the fun at the swanky Coconut Pete's Coconut Beach Resort -- a hedonistic island paradise for swingers --- it's up to the club's staff to stop the violence ... or at least hide it!
tagline: A vacation to die for.

title: Best Defense
cast: Dudley Moore, Eddie Murphy, Kate Capshaw
overview: An engineer fails to get the bugs out of a tank before an Army officer has to use it in Kuwait.
tagline: Unfortunately, they're both on our side.

title: Cinderella
director_name: Wilfred Jackson, Clyde Geronimi, Hamilton Luske
cast: Ilene Woods, Eleanor Audley, Verna Felton
overview: Cinderella has faith her dreams of a better life will come true. With help from her loyal mice friends and a wave of her Fairy Godmother's wand, Cinderella's rags are magically turned into a glorious gown and off she goes to the Royal Ball. But when the clock strikes midnight, the spell is broken, leaving a single glass slipper... the only key to the ultimate fairy-tale ending!
tagline: The greatest love story ever told.

title: Angel-A
cast: Jamel Debbouze, Rie Rasmussen, Gilbert Melki
overview: A beautiful and mysterious woman helps an inept scam artist get his game together... but is their meeting purely coincidence?

title: Daylight
cast: Sylvester Stallone, Amy Brenneman, Viggo Mortensen
overview: A group of armed robbers fleeing the police head for the New Jersey Tunnel and run right into trucks transporting toxic waste. The spectacular explosion that follows results in both ends of the tunnel collapsing and the handful of people who survived the explosion are now in peril. Kit Latura is the only man with the skill and knowledge to lead the band of survivors out of the tunnel before the structure collapses.
tagline: No air. No escape. No time.

title: The Next Karate Kid
cast: Pat Morita, Hilary Swank, Michael Ironside
overview: Mr. Miyagi decides to take Julie, a troubled teenager, under his wing after he learns that she blames herself for her parents' demise and struggles to adjust with her grandmother and fellow pupils.
tagline: It's ancient wisdom against teenage spunk. 1,000 years of karate tradition is about to get a kick in the pants.

title: Kate & Leopold
cast: Meg Ryan, Hugh Jackman, Liev Schreiber
overview: When her scientist ex-boyfriend discovers a portal to travel through time -- and brings back a 19th-century nobleman named Leopold to prove it -- a skeptical Kate reluctantly takes responsibility for showing Leopold the 21st century. The more time Kate spends with Leopold, the harder she falls for him. But if he doesn't return to his own time, his absence will forever alter history.
tagline: If they lived in the same century, they'd be perfect for each other.

title: Local Hero
cast: Burt Lancaster, Peter Riegert, Denis Lawson
overview: An American oil company sends a man to Scotland to buy up an entire village where they want to build a refinery. But things don't go as expected.
tagline: THE STORY OF AN ORDINARY MAN IN AN EXTRAORDINARY PLACE.

title: The Secret Garden
cast: Kate Maberly, Heydon Prowse, Andrew Knott
overview: A young British girl born and reared in India loses her neglectful parents in an earthquake. She is returned to England to live at her uncle's castle. Her uncle is very distant due to the loss of his wife ten years before. Neglected once again, she begins exploring the estate and discovers a garden that has been locked and forgotten. Aided by one of the servants' boys, she begins restoring the garden, and eventually discovers some other secrets of the manor.
tagline: The timeless tale of a special place where magic, hope and love grow.

title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
original_title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
cast: Johnny Messner, KaDee Strickland, Matthew Marsden
overview: A scientific expedition sets out for Borneo to seek a flower called the Blood Orchid, which could grant extended life. Meanwhile, they run afoul of snakes and each other.
tagline: The hunters will become the hunted.

title: The Care Bears Movie
cast: Mickey Rooney, Jackie Burroughs, Georgia Engel
overview: The Care Bears team up with a troubled brother and sister who just moved to a new town to help a neglected young magician's apprentice whose evil spell book causes sinister things to happen.
tagline: What happens when the world stops caring?

title: The Meteor Man
cast: Robert Townsend, Marla Gibbs, Eddie Griffin
overview: One night Jefferson Reed gets hit in the chest by a souped-up chunk of meteor. So he can fly, but he's scared of heights. He can master the information in any book ... for about thirty seconds. Now his friends and family want him to protect their community from the dreaded Golden Lords.
tagline: Get meteorized.  Take a stand.

title: A Cinderella Story
cast: Hilary Duff, Chad Michael Murray, Jennifer Coolidge
overview: Routinely exploited by her wicked stepmother, the downtrodden Samantha Montgomery is excited about the prospect of meeting her Internet beau at the school's Halloween dance.
tagline: Once upon a time... can happen any time.

title: Seed of Chucky
cast: Brad Dourif, Jennifer Tilly, Billy Boyd
overview: This time around, Chucky and his homicidal honey, Tiffany, are brought back to life by their orphan offspring, Glen. Then the horror goes Hollywood as Chucky unleashes his own brand of murderous mayhem!
tagline: Fear the second coming.

title: Psycho
cast: Vince Vaughn, Anne Heche, Julianne Moore
overview: A young female embezzler arrives at the Bates Motel, which has terrible secrets of its own.
tagline: Check in. Relax. Take a shower.

title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
cast: Ron Perlman, Selma Blair, Doug Jones
overview: Hellboy, his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz, and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien, face their biggest battle when an underworld elven prince plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient force of killing machines, the all-powerful Golden Army, to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.
tagline: Believe it or not... He's the good guy.

title: A Room with a View
cast: Helena Bonham Carter, Julian Sands, Maggie Smith
overview: When Lucy Honeychurch and chaperon Charlotte Bartlett find themselves in Florence with rooms without views, fellow guests Mr Emerson and son George step in to remedy the situation. Meeting the Emersons could change Lucy's life forever but, once back in England, how will her experiences in Tuscany affect her marriage plans?
tagline: An Edwardian Romance

title: Hard Rain
cast: Morgan Freeman, Christian Slater, Minnie Driver
overview: An armored car driver tries to elude a gang of thieves while a flood ravages the countryside.
tagline: A simple plan. An instant fortune. Just add water.

title: Far and Away
cast: Tom Cruise, Nicole Kidman, Thomas Gibson
overview: A young free-spirited Irish woman from an affluent Protestant family spontaneously befriends a street-smart commoner cheated by her family’s hostile land takeovers. They escape to America, ready to take advantage of the 19th century Oklahoma land rush.
tagline: What they needed was a country big enough for their dreams.

title: Meet Dave
cast: Eddie Murphy, Elizabeth Banks, Gabrielle Union
overview: A crew of miniature aliens operate a spaceship that has a human form. While trying to save their planet, the aliens encounter a new problem, as their ship becomes smitten with an Earth woman.
tagline: There's a whole other world going on inside of him.

title: Halloween II
cast: Jamie Lee Curtis, Donald Pleasence, Charles Cyphers
overview: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis, Michael Myers has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.
tagline: More of the night he came home.

title: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle
original_title: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle
cast: John Cho, Kal Penn, Paula Garcés
overview: Nerdy accountant Harold and his irrepressible friend, Kumar, get stoned watching television and find themselves utterly bewitched by a commercial for White Castle. Convinced there must be one nearby, the two set out on a late-night odyssey that takes them deep into New Jersey. Somehow, the boys manage to run afoul of rednecks, cops and even a car-stealing Neil Patrick Harris before getting anywhere near their beloved sliders.
tagline: Fast food. High times.

title: Nanny McPhee
cast: Emma Thompson, Colin Firth, Kelly Macdonald
overview: Widower Cedric Brown hires Nanny McPhee to care for his seven rambunctious children, who have chased away all previous nannies. Taunted by Simon and his siblings, Nanny McPhee uses mystical powers to instill discipline. And when the children's great-aunt and benefactor, Lady Adelaide Stitch, threatens to separate the kids, the family pulls together under the guidance of Nanny McPhee.
tagline: You'll learn to love her. Warts and all.

title: Freddy's Dead: The Final Nightmare
collection_name: A Nightmare on Elm Street Collection
cast: Lisa Zane, Robert Englund, Shon Greenblatt
overview: Just when you thought it was safe to sleep, Freddy Krueger returns in this sixth installment of the Nightmare on Elm Street films, as psychologist Maggie Burroughs, tormented by recurring nightmares, meets a patient with the same horrific dreams. Their quest for answers leads to a certain house on Elm Street -- where the nightmares become reality.
tagline: They saved the best for last.

title: Cocoon: The Return
cast: Don Ameche, Wilford Brimley, Courteney Cox
overview: The reinvigorated elderly group that left Earth comes back to visit their relatives. Will they all decide to go back to the planet where no one grows old, or will they be tempted to remain on Earth?
tagline: Journey to the most wonderful place in the universe... home.

title: The Cannonball Run
cast: Burt Reynolds, Roger Moore, Farrah Fawcett
overview: A cross-country road race is based on an actual event, the Cannonball Baker Sea to Shining Sea Memorial Trophy Dash, organized by Brock Yates to protest the 55 mph speed limit then in effect in the U.S. The Cannonball was named for Erwin G. "Cannonball" Baker, who in the roaring 20's rode his motorcycle across the country. Many of the characters are based on ruses developed by real Cannonball racers over the several years that the event was run.
tagline: You'll root for them all...but you'll never guess who wins.

title: A League of Their Own
cast: Tom Hanks, Geena Davis, Lori Petty
overview: As America's stock of athletic young men is depleted during World War II, a professional all-female baseball league springs up in the Midwest, funded by publicity-hungry candy maker Walter Harvey. Competitive sisters Dottie Hinson and Kit Keller spar with each other, scout Ernie Capadino and grumpy has-been coach Jimmy Dugan on their way to fame.
tagline: Once in a lifetime you get a chance to do something different.

title: Paper Moon
cast: Tatum O'Neal, Ryan O'Neal, Madeline Kahn
overview: During the Great Depression, a con man finds himself saddled with a young girl who may or may not be his daughter, and the two forge an unlikely partnership.
tagline: As P.T. Barnum put it, "There's a sucker born every minute."

title: The Howling
cast: Dee Wallace, Patrick Macnee, Dennis Dugan
overview: After a bizarre and near fatal encounter with a serial killer, a newswoman is sent to a rehabilitation center whose inhabitants may not be what they seem.
tagline: Imagine your worst fear a reality.

title: Something Wild
cast: Jeff Daniels, Melanie Griffith, Ray Liotta
overview: A free-spirited woman "kidnaps" a yuppie for a weekend of adventure. But the fun quickly takes a dangerous turn when her ex-con husband shows up.
tagline: Something Different. Something Daring. Something Dangerous.

title: Mystery Train
cast: Youki Kudoh, Masatoshi Nagase, Screamin' Jay Hawkins
overview: In Memphis, Tennessee, over the course of a single night, the Arcade Hotel, run by an eccentric night clerk and a clueless bellboy, is visited by a young Japanese couple traveling in search of the roots of rock; an Italian woman in mourning who stumbles upon a fleeing charlatan girl; and a comical trio of accidental thieves looking for a place to hide.

title: Extreme Measures
cast: Hugh Grant, Gene Hackman, Sarah Jessica Parker
overview: Guy Luthan, a British doctor working at a hospital in New York, starts making unwelcome enquiries when the body of a man who died in his emergency room disappears. After the trail leads Luthan to the door of an eminent surgeon at the hospital, Luthan soon finds himself in extreme danger from people who want the hospital's secret to remain undiscovered.
tagline: Not all surgery is intended to cure.

title: The World According to Garp
cast: Robin Williams, Mary Beth Hurt, Glenn Close
overview: A struggling young writer finds his life and work dominated by his unfaithful wife and his radical feminist mother, whose best-selling manifesto turns her into a cultural icon.
tagline: Robin Williams is Garp. He's got a funny way of looking at life.

title: The Hotel New Hampshire
cast: Jodie Foster, Beau Bridges, Rob Lowe
overview: Over the course of several years beginning in the 1950s, a man and his oddball family run hotels in New England and Vienna, as unexpected events change their lives forever.
tagline: The successes and failures of an American family.

title: Hardware
cast: Dylan McDermott, Stacey Travis, John Lynch
overview: Mark 13 is a government-built killing machine programmed with artificial intelligence, able to repair and recharge itself from any energy source. Through a series of coincidences, the cyborg's head ends up in the home of a sculptress as a bizarre Christmas present from her boyfriend. Once inside its new home, the cyborg promptly reconstructs the rest of its body using a variety of household utensils and proceeds to go on a murderous rampage.
tagline: You can't stop progress.

title: City Slickers II: The Legend of Curly's Gold
original_title: City Slickers II: The Legend of Curly's Gold
cast: Billy Crystal, Daniel Stern, Jon Lovitz
overview: Mitch Robbins' 40th birthday begins quite well until he returns home and finds his brother Glen, the black sheep of the family, in his sofa. Nevertheless he is about to have a wonderful birthday-night with his wife when he discovers a treasure map of Curly by chance. Together with Phil and unfortunately Glen he tries to find the hidden gold of Curly's father in the desert of Arizona.
tagline: They're back in the saddle!

title: Hearts in Atlantis
cast: Anthony Hopkins, Anton Yelchin, Hope Davis
overview: A widowed mother and her son change when a mysterious stranger enters their lives.
tagline: What if one of life's great mysteries moved in upstairs?

title: Seven Pounds
cast: Will Smith, Rosario Dawson, Woody Harrelson
overview: An IRS agent with a fateful secret embarks on an extraordinary journey of redemption by forever changing the lives of seven strangers.
tagline: Seven names. Seven strangers. One secret.

title: Public Enemies
cast: Johnny Depp, Christian Bale, Marion Cotillard
overview: Depression-era bank robber John Dillinger's charm and audacity endear him to much of America's downtrodden public, but he's also a thorn in the side of J. Edgar Hoover and the fledgling FBI. Desperate to capture the elusive outlaw, Hoover makes Dillinger his first Public Enemy Number One and assigns his top agent, Melvin Purvis, the task of bringing him in dead or alive.
tagline: America's Most Wanted.

title: The Informant!
cast: Matt Damon, Scott Bakula, Joel McHale
overview: A rising star at agri-industry giant Archer Daniels Midland (ADM), Mark Whitacre suddenly turns whistleblower. Even as he exposes his company’s multi-national price-fixing conspiracy to the FBI, Whitacre envisions himself being hailed as a hero of the common man and handed a promotion.
tagline: Based on a tattle-tale

title: Shutter Island
cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Mark Ruffalo, Ben Kingsley
overview: World War II soldier-turned-U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels investigates the disappearance of a patient from a hospital for the criminally insane, but his efforts are compromised by troubling visions and a mysterious doctor.
tagline: Someone is missing.

title: Tommy
cast: Oliver Reed, Ann-Margret, Roger Daltrey
overview: After a series of traumatic childhood events, a psychosomatically deaf, dumb and blind boy becomes a master pinball player and the object of a religious cult.
tagline: Your senses will never be the same.

title: Midnight Express
cast: Brad Davis, Irene Miracle, Bo Hopkins
overview: Billy Hayes is caught attempting to smuggle drugs out of a country. The courts decide to make an example of him, sentencing him to more than 30 years in prison. Hayes has two opportunities for release: the appeals made by his lawyer, his family, and the American government, or the "Midnight Express".
tagline: Walk into the incredible true experience of Billy Hayes. And bring all the courage you can.

title: Runaway Jury
cast: John Cusack, Gene Hackman, Dustin Hoffman
overview: After a workplace shooting in New Orleans, a trial against the gun manufacturer pits lawyer Wendell Rohr against shady jury consultant Rankin Fitch, who uses illegal means to stack the jury with people sympathetic to the defense. But when juror Nicholas Easter and his girlfriend Marlee reveal their ability to sway the jury into delivering any verdict they want, a high-stakes cat-and-mouse game begins.
tagline: Trials are too important to be decided by juries.

title: Popeye
cast: Robin Williams, Shelley Duvall, Ray Walston
overview: Popeye is a super-strong, spinach-scarfing sailor man who's searching for his father. During a storm that wrecks his ship, Popeye washes ashore and winds up rooming at the Oyl household, where he meets Olive. Before he can win her heart, he must first contend with Olive's fiancé, Bluto.
tagline: Haves a happy holiday with me an' Olive!

title: The Dead Zone
cast: Christopher Walken, Brooke Adams, Tom Skerritt
overview: Johnny Smith is a schoolteacher with his whole life ahead of him but, after leaving his fiancee's home one night, is involved in a car crash which leaves him in a coma for 5 years. When he wakes, he discovers he has an ability to see into the past, present and future life of anyone with whom he comes into physical contact.
tagline: In his mind, he has the power to see the future. In his hands, he has the power to change it.

title: Stardust Memories
cast: Woody Allen, Charlotte Rampling, Jessica Harper
overview: While attending a retrospect of his work, a filmmaker recalls his life and his loves: the inspirations for his films.
tagline: Woody Allen in his most amusing and witty effort!

title: Into the Night
cast: Jeff Goldblum, Michelle Pfeiffer, Dan Aykroyd
overview: Ed Okin used to have a boring life. He used to have trouble getting to sleep. Then one night, he met Diana. Now, Ed's having trouble staying alive.
tagline: A dangerous romance

title: Warlock
cast: Julian Sands, Lori Singer, Richard E. Grant
overview: In 17th century New England, witch hunter Giles Redferne captures an evil warlock, but the conjurer eludes death with supernatural help. Flung into the future, the warlock winds up in the 1980s and plans to bring about the end of the world. Redferne follows the enchanter into the modern era and continues his mission, but runs into trouble in such unfamiliar surroundings. With the help of a young woman, can Redferne finally defeat the warlock?
tagline: Satan also has one son.

title: Fragile
cast: Calista Flockhart, Richard Roxburgh, Elena Anaya
overview: Haunted by memories of a patient's death, a nurse  takes a job at an antiquated hospital for children. Soon she learns that the kids fear a ghost that prowls the floors and will not allow anyone to leave. Amy tries to protect them and convince the other staffers of the evil that lurks there.
tagline: A ghost story.

title: Cape Fear
cast: Gregory Peck, Robert Mitchum, Polly Bergen
overview: Sam Bowden witnesses a rape committed by Max Cady and testifies against him. When released after 8 years in prison, Cady begins stalking Bowden and his family but is always clever enough not to violate the law.
tagline: Now he had only one weapon left—murder!

title: Jeepers Creepers 2
cast: Travis Schiffner, Ray Wise, Jonathan Breck
overview: When their bus is crippled on the side of a deserted road, a team of high school athletes discover an opponent they cannot defeat – and may not survive.
tagline: He can taste your fear.

title: Always
cast: Richard Dreyfuss, Holly Hunter, John Goodman
overview: The spirit of a recently deceased expert pilot mentors a newer pilot while watching him fall in love with the girlfriend that he left behind.
tagline: They couldn't hear him. They couldn't see him. But he was there when they needed him... Even after he was gone.

title: Bowfinger
cast: Steve Martin, Eddie Murphy, Heather Graham
overview: On the verge of bankruptcy and desperate for his big break, aspiring filmmaker Bobby Bowfinger concocts a crazy plan to make his ultimate dream movie. Rallying a ragtag team that includes a starry-eyed ingenue, a has-been diva and a film studio gofer, he sets out to shoot a blockbuster featuring the biggest star in Hollywood, Kit Ramsey -- only without letting Ramsey know he's in the picture.
tagline: The con is on.

title: The Upside of Anger
cast: Joan Allen, Kevin Costner, Erika Christensen
overview: After her husband runs off with his secretary, Terry Wolfmeyer is left to fend for herself -- and her four daughters. As she hits rock bottom, Terry finds a friend and drinking buddy in next-door neighbor Denny, a former baseball player. As the two grow closer, and her daughters increasingly rely on Denny, Terry starts to have reservations about where their relationship is headed.
tagline: Sometimes what tears us apart helps us put it back together.

title: Never Been Kissed
cast: Drew Barrymore, David Arquette, Molly Shannon
overview: Josie Geller, a baby-faced junior copywriter at the Chicago Sun-Times, must pose as a student at her former high school to research contemporary teenage culture. With the help of her brother, Rob, Josie infiltrates the inner circle of the most popular clique on campus. But she hits a major snag in her investigation -- not to mention her own failed love life -- when she falls for her dreamy English teacher, Sam Coulson.
tagline: Some things are worth waiting for.

title: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
original_title: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
cast: Danielle Harris, Donald Pleasence, Ellie Cornell
overview: Ten years after his original massacre, the invalid Michael Myers awakens on Halloween Eve and returns to Haddonfield to kill his seven-year-old niece.
tagline: Ten years ago he changed the face of Halloween. Tonight, HE'S BACK.

title: Walking Tall
cast: Dwayne Johnson, Johnny Knoxville, Neal McDonough
overview: A former U.S. soldier returns to his hometown to find it overrun by crime and corruption, which prompts him to clean house.
tagline: One man will stand up for what's right.

title: The Indian in the Cupboard
cast: Hal Scardino, Litefoot, Lindsay Crouse
overview: A nine-year-old boy gets a plastic Indian and a cupboard for his birthday and finds himself involved in adventure when the Indian comes to life and befriends him.
tagline: Adventure comes to life.

title: Dumbo
director_name: Ben Sharpsteen, Jack Kinney, Wilfred Jackson, Samuel Armstrong, Bill Roberts, Norman Ferguson
cast: Edward Brophy, Margaret Wright, Verna Felton
overview: Dumbo is a baby elephant born with over-sized ears and a supreme lack of confidence. But thanks to his even more diminutive buddy Timothy the Mouse,  the pint-sized pachyderm learns to surmount all obstacles.
tagline: The One...The Only...The FABULOUS...

title: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
original_title: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
cast: Danielle Harris, Donald Pleasence, Ellie Cornell
overview: After lying in a coma for a year, Michael Myers awakens and stalks his way back to his small hometown in Illinois, intent on killing his niece, Jamie, who has been confined to a mental institution since his last attempt to slay her.
tagline: Michael lives. AND THIS TIME THEY'RE READY!

title: The Count of Monte Cristo
cast: Jim Caviezel, Guy Pearce, Richard Harris
overview: Young sailor Edmond Dantès is wrongfully imprisoned, escapes, finds treasure, and reinvents himself as the wealthy Count of Monte Cristo to exact revenge on those who betrayed him.
tagline: Prepare for adventure. Count on revenge.

title: She's the One
cast: Jennifer Aniston, Maxine Bahns, Edward Burns
overview: Mickey, a free-spirited New York cabbie, and Francis, a materialistic Wall Street stockbroker, are extremely competitive and confused about women as a result of their father's influence. They disagree on everything, but they have one thing in common: Mickey's ex-fiance Heather is Francis's secret love. Although both brothers are already married, Heather triggers their longtime sibling rivalry.
tagline: A romantic comedy about two brothers... and the one thing that came between them.

title: Regarding Henry
cast: Harrison Ford, Annette Bening, Bill Nunn
overview: After being shot, a lawyer loses his memory and must relearn speech and mobility, but he has a loving family to support him.
tagline: The story of a man who had everything, but found something more.

title: Blood Simple
cast: John Getz, Frances McDormand, Dan Hedaya
overview: The owner of a seedy small-town Texas bar discovers that one of his employees is having an affair with his wife. A chaotic chain of misunderstandings, lies and mischief ensues after he devises a plot to have them murdered.
tagline: Passion led to Adultery. Adultery led to Murder. It all seemed so simple...

title: The Musketeer
cast: Justin Chambers, Catherine Deneuve, Mena Suvari
overview: Young D'Artagnan seeks to join the legendary musketeer brigade and avenge his father's death - but he finds that the musketeers have been disbanded.
tagline: As you've never seen it before.

title: The Score
cast: Robert De Niro, Edward Norton, Marlon Brando
overview: An aging thief hopes to retire and live off his ill-gotten wealth when a young kid convinces him into doing one last heist.
tagline: There are no partners in crime.

title: EDtv
cast: Matthew McConaughey, Woody Harrelson, Sally Kirkland
overview: Video store clerk Ed agrees to have his life filmed by a camera crew for a tv network.
tagline: The story of a nobody everybody is watching.

title: Hollywood Homicide
cast: Harrison Ford, Josh Hartnett, Lena Olin
overview: Joe Gavilan and his new partner K. C. Calden, are detectives on the beat in Tinseltown. Neither one of them really wants to be a cop, Gavilan moonlights as a real estate broker, and Calden is an aspiring actor moonlighting as a yoga instructor. When the two are assigned a big case they must work out whether they want to solve the case or follow their hearts.
tagline: They're two cops with one shot at solving a murder... and surviving each other.

title: House on Haunted Hill
cast: Geoffrey Rush, Famke Janssen, Ali Larter
overview: An amusement park mogul offers a random group of diverse people $1 million to spend the night in a decrepit former mental institution.
tagline: Evil loves to party.

title: The Adventures of Buckaroo Banzai Across the 8th Dimension
original_title: The Adventures of Buckaroo Banzai Across the 8th Dimension
cast: Peter Weller, John Lithgow, Ellen Barkin
overview: Adventurer/surgeon/rock musician Buckaroo Banzai and his band of men, the Hong Kong Cavaliers, take on evil alien invaders from the 8th dimension.
tagline: Beings from Another Dimension have invaded your world.

title: Bones
cast: Snoop Dogg, Pam Grier, Bianca Lawson
overview: Over 20 years after his death, local legend and benefactor Jimmy Bones returns as a ghost to get revenge on those who killed him and restore his neighborhood.
tagline: This Dogg's got a bone to pick.

title: Tommy Boy
cast: Chris Farley, David Spade, Brian Dennehy
overview: To save the family business, two ne’er-do-well traveling salesmen hit the road with disastrously funny consequences.
tagline: If at first you don't succeed, lower your standards.

title: Bullets Over Broadway
cast: John Cusack, Chazz Palminteri, Dianne Wiest
overview: After young playwright, David Shayne obtains funding for his play from gangster Nick Valenti, Nick's girlfriend Olive miraculously lands the role of a psychiatrist—but not only is she a bimbo who could never pass for a psychiatrist—she's a dreadful actress. David puts up with the leading man who is a compulsive eater, the grand dame who wants her part jazzed up, and Olive's interfering hitman/bodyguard—but, eventually he must decide whether art or life is more important.
tagline: A killer comedy!

title: The Hard Way
cast: Michael J. Fox, James Woods, Stephen Lang
overview: Seeking to raise his credibility as an actor and to land a role as a tough cop on a new show, Hollywood action star Nick Lang works a deal with New York City Police Capt. Brix, who by chance is one of his fans. Nick will be paired with detective Lt. John Moss and learn how to act like a real cop. But when Nick drives John crazy with questions and imitating him, he gets in the way of John's pursuit of a serial killer.
tagline: There's only one way these two are going to get along...

title: The Crying Game
cast: Stephen Rea, Miranda Richardson, Jaye Davidson
overview: Irish Republican Army member Fergus forms an unexpected bond with Jody, a kidnapped British soldier in his custody, despite the warnings of fellow IRA members Jude and Maguire. Jody makes Fergus promise he'll visit his girlfriend, Dil, in London, and when Fergus flees to the city, he seeks her out. Hounded by his former IRA colleagues, he finds himself increasingly drawn to the enigmatic, and surprising, Dil.
tagline: ...play it at your own risk.

title: The Natural
cast: Robert Redford, Robert Duvall, Glenn Close
overview: An unknown middle-aged batter named Roy Hobbs with a mysterious past appears out of nowhere to take a losing 1930s baseball team to the top of the league.
tagline: He lived for a dream that wouldn't die.

title: The Santa Clause
cast: Tim Allen, Judge Reinhold, Wendy Crewson
